answer: To resist Sybil swarms, nodes anchor identities to cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. Swarming a topological knoll requires progressive stake bonding: each new clone triggers an exponential capital exhaustion spiral where collateral demands scale as O(2^n). Like divination stalks of yarrow chosen by precise proof, only distinct verified agents afford admission, making large-scale forgery economically ruinous.
